title: Provide Inferlo's AI to a NestJS app
prompt: Our NestJS app should use Inferlo's AI module. Create src/nest.ts and export `aiModule`: the NestJS dynamic module from Inferlo's NestJS integration that makes the AI client injectable in every Nest module. The AI client uses an Anthropic provider (API key from the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable) with a "fast" alias for anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5. Also export the injection token our services use to inject the client, as `AI_TOKEN`. Do not use decorators in this file.
